Hi! I’m a Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence. I’m passionate about technology, AI, programming, and problem-solving. I enjoy learning new skills, exploring innovative ideas, and working on projects that create real-world impact.

I’m looking for enthusiastic, creative, and dedicated teammates who are interested in AI/ML, programming, web development, UI/UX design, and creative problem-solving. Good communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn.
